body: From the DM-180 review (orchestrator, this run), for the renderer tests and small fixes: (1) Scorecard points are rounded largest-remainder so they sum to the shown score; say so in the note ('each rounded to one decimal so they add up', ScorecardParts.tsx:205-207) and pin that identical components may differ by 0.1; (2) 'as of <time>' repeats on every attempt row — one line per section; (3) a failed timing read shows its error in both Usage and Attempts; (4) pin the 'as classified' rows when effort is unreported but a classification record exists (Corrective 0 ms · Productive 2 min · Unclassified unavailable) as intended; (5) the Windows row shows the core's raw ISO note.
